movies.title: Inception
movies.synopsis: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea.

movies.title: The Shining
movies.synopsis: A family heads to an isolated hotel for the winter where an evil spiritual presence influences the father into violence.

movies.title: Titanic
movies.synopsis: A seventeen-year-old aristocrat falls in love with a kind, poor artist aboard the luxurious, ill-fated R.M.S. Titanic.

movies.title: Superbad
movies.synopsis: Two co-dependent high school seniors are forced to deal separation anxiety after their plan to stage a booze-soaked party goes awry.

movies.title: The Dark Knight
movies.synopsis: When the menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on the people of Gotham, Batman must accept one of the greatest psychological and physical tests.

movies.title: Knives Out
movies.synopsis: A detective investigates the death of a patriarch of an eccentric, combative family.

movies.title: Forrest Gump
movies.synopsis: The presidencies of Kennedy and Johnson, the Vietnam War, and other historical events unfold from the perspective of an Alabama man with an low IQ.

movies.title: The Mask
movies.synopsis: Bank clerk Stanley Ipkiss transforms into a manic superhero when he wears a mysterious ancient mask.

movies.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
movies.synopsis: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a woman rebels against a tyrannical ruler in search for her homeland with the help of a group of female prisoners.

movies.title: Coraline
movies.synopsis: An adventurous girl finds another world that is a strangely idealized version of her darkly frustrating home, but it has sinister secrets.

movies.title: Elf
movies.synopsis: Raised as an oversized elf, a human travels from the North Pole to New York City to meet his biological father.

movies.title: Step Brothers
movies.synopsis: Two aimless middle-aged men still living at home are forced to become roommates when their parents marry.

movies.title: Jurassic Park
movies.synopsis: During a preview tour, a theme park suffers a major power breakdown that allows its cloned dinosaur exhibits to run loose.

movies.title: A Quiet Place
movies.synopsis: A family must live in silence while hiding from creatures that hunt by sound.

movies.title: The Lion King
movies.synopsis: Lion prince Simba and his father are targeted by his bitter uncle, who wants to ascend the throne himself.
